issue: API returns 500 on special characters in query params

observations.detail: Created src/sanitize/query.ts as a reusable sanitisation module. The pattern is: validate → clean → normalise → return a SanitizeResult with valid/value/reason fields. Controllers should call sanitizeQuery() before processing user input and return 400 when valid is false.

SQL injection is intentionally NOT handled in the sanitiser. It must be handled by the data-access layer using parameterised queries. The sanitiser focuses on input that is dangerous before it reaches any query builder (null bytes, path traversal, malformed Unicode).

The TypeError 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading normalize)' in SearchController.search was caused by calling .normalize() on a value that was undefined or mangled by upstream encoding mishandling. The fix normalises to NFC in the sanitiser so downstream code always receives a valid string.

The master branch had no real tests (package.json test script was just echo). Added npx tsx runner for the new query-sanitize.test.ts with 15 test cases covering null bytes, path traversal, Unicode/emoji, SQL passthrough, and edge cases (undefined, null, non-string, empty).
Added src/sanitize/query.ts for input sanitisation utilities. This follows the existing src/<domain>/<module>.ts pattern used by src/cache/store.ts. Tests go in src/__tests__/query-sanitize.test.ts.
